item.title: High speed not ‘sine qua non’ to constitute offence under Section 279 IPC; Del HC grants leave to appeal against acquittal
item.description: “Possibility of rashness and negligence by a driver cannot be negated on the mere account of low speed, especially when it is alleged that the respondent was driving a heavy vehicle, carrying material over the permissible weight limit, in a zig-zag manner prior to the accident.” The post High speed not ‘sine qua non’ to constitute offence under Section 279 IPC; Del HC grants leave to appeal against acquittal appeared first on SCC Times.
